Current integration head

**HOLD until this exact head completes its own applicable CI.** Head `6a8c297b3f8f21506d11c2cb093c1c58d84ffe55`, tree `635d02f8f2b8151ae4697365e1962b070e4015a3`.

The two parents are the prior #817 integration `2aa206882c7d6298d74ddc1ddf3a4ccb052e41a6` and #819 v14 `635c57bd7fd0b9f37480b4da091af4dddfd53a36`. Both completed **19/19 workflows successfully**, all attempt 1. Their qualifications remain specific to their own commits. The frozen package preserves the first parent's earlier 18/19 snapshot; its final [native NDU run](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/actions/runs/42554362013) subsequently succeeded without retry or cancellation.

## Why and resulting behavior

The Part04 repair rejects successful syscalls observed after the fixed cleanup deadline and prevents a fixture clock from compressing a separate two-second cleanup budget to 20 ms. #816 supplies loader-page/GOT binding, retained lease identity and complete cohort accounting. #819 incorporates those repairs, adds bounded u16/v14 support and validates actual copied output fragments from the original Agent select task.

The independently developed fixture corrections overlap. Taking either side wholesale would drop cleanup assertions, a timeout premise or the complete test inventory. This commit retains both source histories and combines three fixture files:

| Conflict | Integrated behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Known descendant observation | Record PID and start time; check group membership only while the original identity matches. Retain every cleanup assertion and time observation. A late terminal read still fails the original 1.5-second whole-test deadline. |
| Relocation timeout fixture | Preserve checkpoint and elapsed modes, plus configurable checkpoint readiness. Cleanup advances in real time in both modes. |
| Preoutput timeout control | Exercise both original premises as subtests of one existing method; both require an empty marker prefix and zero observed stream bytes. |

The initialization workflow retains **723 distinct control IDs** and disjoint-union checks. The production collector and both consumers have identical bytes in both parents and this head. The 60-second process, two-second cleanup, 50 ms pending-EIO and byte budgets are unchanged. The receipt covers the owned leader and captured streams; it does not establish individual termination of every possible descendant.

## Preserved source and evidence

Relative to the first parent, **43 paths** change: 35 reuse exact #819 blobs and eight are the three combined fixtures plus this integration's report/evidence. The source tree before adding reports was `9ff1b36fb59858145e0d46010289a15fb91a3437`. Both parents' complete file sets remain, including five first-parent-only evidence paths and 44 identical shared changed blobs.

The u16 compiler, v14 support matrix, language coverage, original copied-fragment qualifier/replayer and their historical evidence are #819's exact bytes. The copied-fragment result remains scoped to five original scalar types, initialized normalized slots and a 35-byte output fragment. Five proofs and five independent rechecks concern the same **25 obligations**, not 50 different properties. The 200 projection calls and 64 complete-program finite calls are separate observations. These results do not establish whole-compiler correctness or original Agent evaluation/adoption.

## Validation and retained failures

- Fresh focused fixture run: **8/8 methods PASS**, zero failures/errors/skips/expected failures/unexpected successes. Both preoutput subtests passed. Unittest reported 41.241 seconds; the wrapper including suite loading measured 41.410937 seconds.
- Four separate injected read-observation controls: one accepted replacement identity, and three required refusals for a changed group, persistent live state and late replacement. They do not reproduce real PID reuse or add four new unique methods.
- Inventory check retains all 709 original IDs, #816's three and #817's eleven disjoint additions: **723**, with capture/Part04-runner/relocation inventories at 41/17/23. Inventory loading executes no test methods.
- Root and an independent reader checked parent provenance, fixture semantics, raw reports, hashes and documentation. The new **52,564-byte archive**, SHA256 `c5c8503b72cce2f7ee86b5110786fc9a80f8713d9959b05740345a107394e996`, contains **35 members / 1,372,821 original bytes**, all independently rehashed.
- The earlier #817 108-method attempt remains **107 PASS / 1 FAIL**, zero errors. #819 retains a different 108-method attempt with **1 FAIL / 1 ERROR**. Neither original result is replaced, combined with the other or relabeled green. Their historical timing/source causes retain the limits stated in the reports.
- Original #817's 105-method qualification and the first integration's [80-job initialization CI](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Hepta/actions/runs/42554362067) retain their own subjects. Of that integration's 19 workflows, 17 explicitly checked out its head and two used a prospective merge commit with the identical tree.

No compiler, loader mutation, solver or full 108-method suite was run locally during this fixture reconciliation. The new head requires its own complete applicable CI.

## Merge and acceptance boundary

The target remains source branch `codex/hia-sixgap-source-5e6c-20261108` under #808. **Do not retarget this source tree to metadata-only main.** #818 and #820 separately establish the selected public v9 lock and timestamped formal installation readback. This PR alone does not change the public default or activate v14 online.

Complete general Core selfhosting, general compiler/ABI/resources/FFI/ISA/loader correctness, the original unfamiliar Agent's missing semantic/lowering claims and full provider costs, and stable NDU economic value remain open. **Overall six-track acceptance remains HOLD.**

Details: [v14 integration report](docs/HIA_V14_FIXTURE_INTEGRATION_20261109.md), [new evidence package](review-evidence/hia-v14-fixture-integration-20261109-e5ee/), [prior integration report](docs/HIA_PART04_FIXTURE_INTEGRATION_20261109.md), and [original deadline repair](docs/HIA_PART04_DEADLINE_CLOSURE_20261108.md).
